messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

What they do support is that AI data centers are moving toward much higher-speed electrical/optical links, denser power, and liquid-cooling infrastructure, while wireless test instruments are separately evolving toward wider bandwidth, more MIMO/RF-chain, OTA, multi-technology, throughput/IP, fading, and automation capabilities [50][51][52][55][13].
### Supported technology changes in AI data centers
AI/data-center connectivity is described as a “full-spectrum” portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [50].
High-speed electrical examples include OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with aggregate bandwidths of 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T per cable assembly; XtremePass 448G connector solutions; and Celerity 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors [55].
Optical examples include XPO-LPO at 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments and 1.6T OSFP transceivers using 200G/lane optical modules [51].
### Implications for wireless / signaling test instruments
For Wi-Fi 7 and next-generation WLAN devices, OTA testing in signaling mode is used to measure antennas and RF transmitter/receiver characteristics under real-world conditions [1].
Because MLO is a key Wi-Fi 7 feature, a test environment with multiple RF chains is described as critical [1].
Wi-Fi 7 throughput-related components include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM, and MLO [3].
Therefore, signaling testers used for Wi-Fi 7 development need to address OTA MIMO stress testing, realistic multipath RF conditions, antenna/RF TX/RX behavior, and multi-antenna performance for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points [2][5].
The R&S CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester, and the passages list support for LTE, 5G NR FR1, 5G NR FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G RedCap in OTA measurement environments [6].
The CMX500 feature summary also lists NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements including 802.11be and 2x2 MIMO, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and automation interfaces [13].
In a Bluetest OTA workflow, CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS and Bluetest Flow supports 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, LTE, and WLAN OTA testing, and WLAN capability was expanded to Wi-Fi 7 320 MHz bandwidth support [21].
However, that same knowledge base notes this is PR/upgrade evidence and not a binding formal specification for RFU18 order number, bandwidth, throughput, or test conditions [64].
### Implications for non-signaling test instruments
For non-signaling and production-style testing, the RAW passage describes Wireless Manufacturing Test as a modular software framework tailored for high-volume production testing and non-signaling R&D applications [66].
The R&S PVT360A is described as a Performance Vector Tester that can provide multi-wireless-standard waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, and external frontend frequency extension [46].
Its NR waveform playback capabilities include 1 to 16 carriers and per-carrier channel bandwidths up to 400 MHz, with release 17/18 waveform additions including 480 kHz / 960 kHz subcarrier spacing and 1024QAM [48].
Its spectrum analysis option provides I/Q-based spectrum analysis, frequency sweep power-vs-frequency, zero-span power-vs-time, marker evaluation, peak search, and TOI results [49].
A RAW passage also states that the R&S CMP180 can verify a 480 MHz bandwidth signal waveform in loopback mode and is positioned for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7 requirements [67].
### Practical separation of required capabilities
| Instrument role | Measurement capability that becomes more relevant | Passage-supported basis |
|---|---|---|
| Signaling / network-emulation tester | Multi-technology, multi-channel signaling across LTE, NR FR1/FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and RedCap | CMX500 is described as multi-technology/multi-channel and supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G RedCap in OTA contexts.[6] |
| Signaling / Wi-Fi 7 OTA tester | OTA, real-world signaling-mode RF and antenna measurement, MIMO stress, multiple RF chains | Wi-Fi 7 device development needs real-world signaling-mode antenna and RF TX/RX measurement, and MLO makes multiple RF chains critical.[1] |
| Signaling / throughput and protocol tester | Throughput, PER, BLER, CSI, fading, AWGN, IP traffic analysis, application testing | CMX500 feature summary lists fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, and IP traffic analysis.[13] |
| Signaling / future cellular tester | FR1/FR2/FR3, higher data rate, 4096QAM, more antenna ports, NTN/D2C/Wi-Fi 7/Wi-Fi 8 readiness | CMX500 PR states FR1/FR2/FR3, up to 20 Gbps, 4096QAM, up to 16 device antenna ports, and support positioning for NTN, D2C, Wi-Fi 7, and future Wi-Fi 8.[63] |
| Non-signaling R&D / production tester | High-volume production framework and non-signaling R&D workflow | Wireless Manufacturing Test is described as a modular software framework for high-volume production testing and non-signaling R&D applications.[66] |
| Non-signaling waveform / RF tester | Wider waveform playback, TX/RX, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, multi-carrier NR | PVT360A provides waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, and external frontend frequency extension; its NR waveform playback supports 1 to 16 carriers and up to 400 MHz per-carrier bandwidth.[46][48] |
| Non-signaling wideband waveform tester | 480 MHz waveform verification for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7 | CMP180 is stated to verify a 480 MHz bandwidth signal waveform in loopback mode and to be positioned for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7.[67] |
### Inference
【推論】Because AI data-center connectivity is moving toward 224G/lane, 448G, 1.6T optical/electrical interconnects and denser power/cooling systems, wireless testers are not shown as directly measuring those data-center interconnects; instead, the relevant wireless/signaling requirement is to keep pace with adjacent wireless-device complexity such as Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO, MLO, 320 MHz bandwidth, multi-RF-chain operation, FR1/FR2/FR3, high throughput, and IP/application-layer validation.[50][51][52][55][1][2][3][13][63]
【推論】For non-signaling instruments, the measurement capability trend is toward production-scalable waveform generation/playback, TX/RX and spectrum analysis, wider bandwidth verification, and multi-carrier NR/WLAN support, because WMT is described for high-volume production and non-signaling R&D, PVT360A supports waveform playback/TX/RX/spectrum/WLAN MIMO, and CMP180 is stated to verify 480 MHz bandwidth waveforms.[66][46][48][49][67]

What they do support is that AI data centers are moving toward much higher-speed electrical/optical links, denser power, and liquid-cooling infrastructure, while wireless test instruments are separately evolving toward wider bandwidth, more MIMO/RF-chain, OTA, multi-technology, throughput/IP, fading, and automation capabilities [50][51][52][55][13].
### Supported technology changes in AI data centers
AI/data-center connectivity is described as a “full-spectrum” portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [50].
High-speed electrical examples include OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with aggregate bandwidths of 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T per cable assembly; XtremePass 448G connector solutions; and Celerity 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors [55].
Optical examples include XPO-LPO at 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments and 1.6T OSFP transceivers using 200G/lane optical modules [51].
### Implications for wireless / signaling test instruments
For Wi-Fi 7 and next-generation WLAN devices, OTA testing in signaling mode is used to measure antennas and RF transmitter/receiver characteristics under real-world conditions [1].
Because MLO is a key Wi-Fi 7 feature, a test environment with multiple RF chains is described as critical [1].
Wi-Fi 7 throughput-related components include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM, and MLO [3].
Therefore, signaling testers used for Wi-Fi 7 development need to address OTA MIMO stress testing, realistic multipath RF conditions, antenna/RF TX/RX behavior, and multi-antenna performance for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points [2][5].
The R&S CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester, and the passages list support for LTE, 5G NR FR1, 5G NR FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G RedCap in OTA measurement environments [6].
The CMX500 feature summary also lists NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements including 802.11be and 2x2 MIMO, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and automation interfaces [13].
In a Bluetest OTA workflow, CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS and Bluetest Flow supports 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, LTE, and WLAN OTA testing, and WLAN capability was expanded to Wi-Fi 7 320 MHz bandwidth support [21].
However, that same knowledge base notes this is PR/upgrade evidence and not a binding formal specification for RFU18 order number, bandwidth, throughput, or test conditions [64].
### Implications for non-signaling test instruments
For non-signaling and production-style testing, the RAW passage describes Wireless Manufacturing Test as a modular software framework tailored for high-volume production testing and non-signaling R&D applications [66].
The R&S PVT360A is described as a Performance Vector Tester that can provide multi-wireless-standard waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, and external frontend frequency extension [46].
Its NR waveform playback capabilities include 1 to 16 carriers and per-carrier channel bandwidths up to 400 MHz, with release 17/18 waveform additions including 480 kHz / 960 kHz subcarrier spacing and 1024QAM [48].
Its spectrum analysis option provides I/Q-based spectrum analysis, frequency sweep power-vs-frequency, zero-span power-vs-time, marker evaluation, peak search, and TOI results [49].
A RAW passage also states that the R&S CMP180 can verify a 480 MHz bandwidth signal waveform in loopback mode and is positioned for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7 requirements [67].
### Practical separation of required capabilities
| Instrument role | Measurement capability that becomes more relevant | Passage-supported basis |
|---|---|---|
| Signaling / network-emulation tester | Multi-technology, multi-channel signaling across LTE, NR FR1/FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and RedCap | CMX500 is described as multi-technology/multi-channel and supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G RedCap in OTA contexts.[6] |
| Signaling / Wi-Fi 7 OTA tester | OTA, real-world signaling-mode RF and antenna measurement, MIMO stress, multiple RF chains | Wi-Fi 7 device development needs real-world signaling-mode antenna and RF TX/RX measurement, and MLO makes multiple RF chains critical.[1] |
| Signaling / throughput and protocol tester | Throughput, PER, BLER, CSI, fading, AWGN, IP traffic analysis, application testing | CMX500 feature summary lists fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, and IP traffic analysis.[13] |
| Signaling / future cellular tester | FR1/FR2/FR3, higher data rate, 4096QAM, more antenna ports, NTN/D2C/Wi-Fi 7/Wi-Fi 8 readiness | CMX500 PR states FR1/FR2/FR3, up to 20 Gbps, 4096QAM, up to 16 device antenna ports, and support positioning for NTN, D2C, Wi-Fi 7, and future Wi-Fi 8.[63] |
| Non-signaling R&D / production tester | High-volume production framework and non-signaling R&D workflow | Wireless Manufacturing Test is described as a modular software framework for high-volume production testing and non-signaling R&D applications.[66] |
| Non-signaling waveform / RF tester | Wider waveform playback, TX/RX, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, multi-carrier NR | PVT360A provides waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, and external frontend frequency extension; its NR waveform playback supports 1 to 16 carriers and up to 400 MHz per-carrier bandwidth.[46][48] |
| Non-signaling wideband waveform tester | 480 MHz waveform verification for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7 | CMP180 is stated to verify a 480 MHz bandwidth signal waveform in loopback mode and to be positioned for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7.[67] |
### Inference
【推論】Because AI data-center connectivity is moving toward 224G/lane, 448G, 1.6T optical/electrical interconnects and denser power/cooling systems, wireless testers are not shown as directly measuring those data-center interconnects; instead, the relevant wireless/signaling requirement is to keep pace with adjacent wireless-device complexity such as Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO, MLO, 320 MHz bandwidth, multi-RF-chain operation, FR1/FR2/FR3, high throughput, and IP/application-layer validation.[50][51][52][55][1][2][3][13][63]
【推論】For non-signaling instruments, the measurement capability trend is toward production-scalable waveform generation/playback, TX/RX and spectrum analysis, wider bandwidth verification, and multi-carrier NR/WLAN support, because WMT is described for high-volume production and non-signaling R&D, PVT360A supports waveform playback/TX/RX/spectrum/WLAN MIMO, and CMP180 is stated to verify 480 MHz bandwidth waveforms.[66][46][48][49][67]

answer.question: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester? Please focus on implications for wireless/signaling and non-signaling test instruments.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 來源中的測試架構
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）描述的架構為：

- [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 提供 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] control software / integrated test environment 整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS），例如 [[Bluetest RTS65]]，提供 reverberation chamber OTA environment。
- 測試對象為 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points。
- 測試目標為 MIMO stress testing under realistic conditions。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[Bluetest]] expanded its earlier integrated testing capabilities for [[WLAN]] stations and access points（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] 現在支援 bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。
- 此能力與 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 [[Bluetest]] RTS 組成 single tester and reverberation test system 的 integrated path。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）補充：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可 combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 整合 enables support of [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為支援 non-cellular technologies including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，all in a single instrument。
- [[EMITE]] customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] as well as [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 可追溯範圍與限制
- 本頁目前由 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]]、[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 支撐。
- 本頁不推論 [[R&S CMX500]] 或 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 實際支援的 RF chains 數量、spatial streams 數量、MLO link combination、software option code 或 hardware configuration。
- 本頁不推論 [[Bluetest RTS65]]、其他 Bluetest RTS chambers 或 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的完整規格、measurement uncertainty、校準流程或 certification applicability。
- 本頁不把新聞稿中的 solution positioning 視為 conformance test coverage 或正式規格。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 標示 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，但未提供 release date、release notes、license requirement 或相容性矩陣。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的測試項目、標準版本、認證機構或是否等同正式 conformance / certification testing。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing
[[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 是在 over-the-air、signaling mode 與 realistic multipath RF conditions 下，對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 的 antenna、RF transmitter / receiver 與 multi-antenna performance 進行壓力測試的測試情境。新匯入的 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 補充另一個 partner integration 視角：[[EMITE]] OTA chambers 可整合 [[R&S CMX500]] 最新測試能力，用於 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]] device performance assessment。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 來源中的測試架構
依 [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]]：

- [[EMITE]] over-the-air chambers 可與 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 latest sophisticated testing features combined。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology、multi-channel one-box signaling tester。
- cellular technologies：[[LTE]]、[[5G NR]] [[NR FR1]] frequency range up to 8 GHz、[[NR FR2]] millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz、latest [[5G RedCap]]。
- non-cellular technologies：latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]。
- integration enables support of LTE、FR1、FR2、full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]]。
- EMITE customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing performance of [[Wi-Fi 7]] and [[5G RedCap]] devices。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 5G RedCap 部分
來源對 [[RedCap]] / [[5G RedCap]] 的定義：

- [[3GPP Release 17]] defined 5G technology。
- reduced-functionality version of 5G。
- significantly lower cost compared to [[5G eMBB]]。
- mid-range data throughput。
- low power consumption。
- low complexity。
- ability to support a large number of devices。
- particularly attractive for [[IoT]] applications。

本頁只記錄來源中的 solution-level 說法；不推論 RedCap UE category、band support、3GPP test case coverage、RF measurements、protocol conformance 或 certification scope。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › Wi-Fi 7 部分
來源將 [[IEEE 802.11be]] 與 [[Wi-Fi 7]] 視為同一段背景，描述為 next generation of Wi-Fi technology，目標是 extremely high data throughput，far surpassing [[IEEE 802.11ax]] / [[Wi-Fi 6]] / [[Wi-Fi 6E]]。

來源提到的應用需求：

- tens of gigabits of data per second。
- low latency。
- ultra-high-definition video streaming。
- immersive virtual reality。
- augmented reality applications。

本頁不從這段背景推論 [[R&S CMX500]] + [[EMITE]] chamber 實際支援的 channel bandwidth、spatial streams、MLO combination、MIMO layers 或 throughput 數值。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 使用限制
- 來源未標示發布日期。
- 來源未標示 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers 的硬體 BOM、software option code、CSW version、RF chain count 或 license requirement。
- 來源未標示 [[EMITE]] chamber 型號、頻率範圍、DUT 尺寸、load condition、校準程序、measurement uncertainty 或 conformance applicability。
- 來源使用 full compliance with [[IEEE 802.11be]] and [[5G RedCap]] 的語句，但未展開 compliance 的標準版本、測試項目、pass/fail criteria 或認證機構。
- 來源未列出 [[Wi-Fi 7]]、[[5G RedCap]]、[[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]] 的完整 test case list。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 下一步：NTN
來源說明下一步合作方向是 integrating test capabilities for [[NB-IoT NTN]] and [[NR NTN]]，且這些能力 already covered by [[R&S CMW500]] and [[R&S CMX500]]。

這句話只能證明該 PR 對 roadmap / collaboration next step 的描述；來源未提供 [[NB-IoT NTN]] 或 [[NR NTN]] 的 option code、software version、test case list、hardware configuration 或正式規格條件。

Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap OTA measurements › 與 Bluetest OTA 來源的關係
本頁與 [[Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing]] 互補：

- [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 聚焦 [[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems、[[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA MIMO stress testing 與 [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 聚焦 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18 與 4G / 5G NR / WLAN OTA workflow。
- [[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 聚焦 [[EMITE]] OTA chambers、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G RedCap]]，並提到 [[NB-IoT NTN]] / [[NR NTN]] 作為下一步。

What they do support is that AI data centers are moving toward much higher-speed electrical/optical links, denser power, and liquid-cooling infrastructure, while wireless test instruments are separately evolving toward wider bandwidth, more MIMO/RF-chain, OTA, multi-technology, throughput/IP, fading, and automation capabilities [50][51][52][55][13].
### Supported technology changes in AI data centers
AI/data-center connectivity is described as a “full-spectrum” portfolio covering high-speed electrical interconnect, optical interconnect, fiber deployment, rack power distribution, busbar, liquid cooling, and leak detection [50].
High-speed electrical examples include OSFP cable assemblies from 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4 with aggregate bandwidths of 200G, 400G, 800G, and 1.6T per cable assembly; XtremePass 448G connector solutions; and Celerity 224 Gb/s PAM4 mezzanine connectors [55].
Optical examples include XPO-LPO at 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels for AI scale-up deployments and 1.6T OSFP transceivers using 200G/lane optical modules [51].
### Implications for wireless / signaling test instruments
For Wi-Fi 7 and next-generation WLAN devices, OTA testing in signaling mode is used to measure antennas and RF transmitter/receiver characteristics under real-world conditions [1].
Because MLO is a key Wi-Fi 7 feature, a test environment with multiple RF chains is described as critical [1].
Wi-Fi 7 throughput-related components include 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM, and MLO [3].
Therefore, signaling testers used for Wi-Fi 7 development need to address OTA MIMO stress testing, realistic multipath RF conditions, antenna/RF TX/RX behavior, and multi-antenna performance for IEEE 802.11be stations and access points [2][5].
The R&S CMX500 is described as a multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester, and the passages list support for LTE, 5G NR FR1, 5G NR FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G RedCap in OTA measurement environments [6].
The CMX500 feature summary also lists NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling and measurements, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements including 802.11be and 2x2 MIMO, plus fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, and automation interfaces [13].
In a Bluetest OTA workflow, CMX500 OBT with Bluetest RTS and Bluetest Flow supports 5G NR SA, 5G NR NSA, LTE, and WLAN OTA testing, and WLAN capability was expanded to Wi-Fi 7 320 MHz bandwidth support [21].
However, that same knowledge base notes this is PR/upgrade evidence and not a binding formal specification for RFU18 order number, bandwidth, throughput, or test conditions [64].
### Implications for non-signaling test instruments
For non-signaling and production-style testing, the RAW passage describes Wireless Manufacturing Test as a modular software framework tailored for high-volume production testing and non-signaling R&D applications [66].
The R&S PVT360A is described as a Performance Vector Tester that can provide multi-wireless-standard waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, and external frontend frequency extension [46].
Its NR waveform playback capabilities include 1 to 16 carriers and per-carrier channel bandwidths up to 400 MHz, with release 17/18 waveform additions including 480 kHz / 960 kHz subcarrier spacing and 1024QAM [48].
Its spectrum analysis option provides I/Q-based spectrum analysis, frequency sweep power-vs-frequency, zero-span power-vs-time, marker evaluation, peak search, and TOI results [49].
A RAW passage also states that the R&S CMP180 can verify a 480 MHz bandwidth signal waveform in loopback mode and is positioned for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7 requirements [67].
### Practical separation of required capabilities
| Instrument role | Measurement capability that becomes more relevant | Passage-supported basis |
|---|---|---|
| Signaling / network-emulation tester | Multi-technology, multi-channel signaling across LTE, NR FR1/FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and RedCap | CMX500 is described as multi-technology/multi-channel and supports LTE, NR FR1/FR2, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G RedCap in OTA contexts.[6] |
| Signaling / Wi-Fi 7 OTA tester | OTA, real-world signaling-mode RF and antenna measurement, MIMO stress, multiple RF chains | Wi-Fi 7 device development needs real-world signaling-mode antenna and RF TX/RX measurement, and MLO makes multiple RF chains critical.[1] |
| Signaling / throughput and protocol tester | Throughput, PER, BLER, CSI, fading, AWGN, IP traffic analysis, application testing | CMX500 feature summary lists fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, and IP traffic analysis.[13] |
| Signaling / future cellular tester | FR1/FR2/FR3, higher data rate, 4096QAM, more antenna ports, NTN/D2C/Wi-Fi 7/Wi-Fi 8 readiness | CMX500 PR states FR1/FR2/FR3, up to 20 Gbps, 4096QAM, up to 16 device antenna ports, and support positioning for NTN, D2C, Wi-Fi 7, and future Wi-Fi 8.[63] |
| Non-signaling R&D / production tester | High-volume production framework and non-signaling R&D workflow | Wireless Manufacturing Test is described as a modular software framework for high-volume production testing and non-signaling R&D applications.[66] |
| Non-signaling waveform / RF tester | Wider waveform playback, TX/RX, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, multi-carrier NR | PVT360A provides waveform playback, TX/RX measurements, spectrum analysis, WLAN MIMO, and external frontend frequency extension; its NR waveform playback supports 1 to 16 carriers and up to 400 MHz per-carrier bandwidth.[46][48] |
| Non-signaling wideband waveform tester | 480 MHz waveform verification for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7 | CMP180 is stated to verify a 480 MHz bandwidth signal waveform in loopback mode and to be positioned for R&D and production beyond Wi-Fi 7.[67] |
### Inference
【推論】Because AI data-center connectivity is moving toward 224G/lane, 448G, 1.6T optical/electrical interconnects and denser power/cooling systems, wireless testers are not shown as directly measuring those data-center interconnects; instead, the relevant wireless/signaling requirement is to keep pace with adjacent wireless-device complexity such as Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO, MLO, 320 MHz bandwidth, multi-RF-chain operation, FR1/FR2/FR3, high throughput, and IP/application-layer validation.[50][51][52][55][1][2][3][13][63]
【推論】For non-signaling instruments, the measurement capability trend is toward production-scalable waveform generation/playback, TX/RX and spectrum analysis, wider bandwidth verification, and multi-carrier NR/WLAN support, because WMT is described for high-volume production and non-signaling R&D, PVT360A supports waveform playback/TX/RX/spectrum/WLAN MIMO, and CMP180 is stated to verify 480 MHz bandwidth waveforms.[66][46][48][49][67]

Data center full-spectrum connectivity
[[Data center full-spectrum connectivity]] 是 [[full-spectrum-data-center-connectivity-brochure]] 呈現的 portfolio 視角：把 AI / data center 的 high-speed electrical interconnect、optical interconnect、fiber deployment、rack power distribution、busbar、liquid cooling 與 leak detection 放在同一張 data center connectivity brochure 中。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Optical 與 fiber connectivity
- [[Amphenol XPO-LPO]] — 來源稱其以 224 Gb/s per lane across 64 channels，面向 AI scale-up deployments。
- [[1.6T OSFP Transceivers]] — 來源稱 Amphenol 200G/lane optical modules support DR4、FR4、2×DR4、2×FR4、AOC、breakout AOC configurations with LC or MPO ports。

- [[300G CXP2 Active Optical Cable]] — 來源稱 CXP2 to CXP2 AOC provides cost-effective plug and play cabling solution，delivers high hardware faceplate port density among existing SFF industry standards。
- [[CommScope Rapid Fiber Connect Platform]] — 來源稱其 simplifies and accelerates AI scaling by pre-integrating optics off-site and reducing on-site fiber connections。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › Power 與 cooling connectivity
- [[Amphenol BarKlip I-O products]] / [[BarKlip Busbar Connectors]] — 來源稱其 distribute high-current power between busbars、cables and circuit boards，適用 power-dense data centers、OCP rack and power solutions。

- [[M-CRPS +54V Connectors and Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱其 meet OCP M-CRPS power supply input specifications。
- [[PwrBlade ULTRA HD+ Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 Cable-to-Board serves as high-power I/O cable configuration in a low-profile design。
- [[OSFP-RHS 224G Cold Plate and Cage Assembly]] — 來源稱其 optimizes port thermal efficiency and reliability，meeting MSA requirements，並提供 one-step press assembly。
- [[Amphenol Liquid Cooling Leakage Detection Sensor Cable Assembly]] — 來源稱其 detects coolant leaks and ensures system reliability。
- [[Liquid Cooling Quick Disconnect Connectors]] — 來源稱其用於 high-efficiency thermal management。

Data center full-spectrum connectivity › High-speed electrical connectivity
- [[Amphenol OverPass Cable Systems]] — 來源稱其 enable high-speed signal transmission from ASIC packages to end-points across the system。
- [[ExtremePort OSFP Connectors]] — 來源稱 connectors and cages have 60 contacts per port、0.6 mm pitch，並 optimized for signal integrity、thermal management and multi-lane pluggable architecture。
- [[Amphenol XtremePass]] — 來源稱 XtremePass 448G connector solution supports scalable form factors from 32DP to 128DP，並跨 Ethernet、NVLink、PCIe、InfiniBand systems。
- [[OSFP Cable Assemblies]] — 來源稱 OSFP cable assemblies compatible with 25G/lane NRZ up to 224G/lane PAM4，deliver aggregate bandwidths of 200G、400G、800G and 1.6T per cable assembly，available in Passive and Active variants。

- [[Celerity 224 Gb-s BGA Mezzanine Connectors]] — 來源稱其 designed to support data rates up to 224 Gb/s PAM4。

Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness › 重點摘要

Rohde & Schwarz demonstrates FR1–FR3 carrier aggregation, advancing 6G readiness › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks]] 描述 13 GHz proposed [[FR3]] [[5G NR]] high-throughput demonstration，未提 [[RFU18]]；本來源進一步說明 [[R&S CMX500]] 透過 new [[RFU18]] board coverage up to 18 GHz，並把 demo 從 13 GHz single connection 擴展到 FR1 約 2.5 GHz + FR3 約 7 GHz carrier aggregation。
- 既有 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] 記錄 2026-02-26 battle card 對 [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz 與 max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz 的 sales claims。本來源是 Rohde & Schwarz PR，能支撐 RFU18 up to 18 GHz 與 CMX500 + RFU18 的 FR1-FR3 CA demo claim；但來源仍未提供 RFU18 order number、formal specifications 文件編號、測試條件、bandwidth 或 throughput 數字，因此不能直接替代 formal datasheet。
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 記錄正式 Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），其中 [[R&S CMX-B600B]] RF unit frequency range 為 400 MHz to 8000 MHz，[[R&S CMX-B500A]] 為 IF unit。新來源說 all existing CMX500 platforms can be enhanced with [[RFU18]] board to extend frequency coverage；判斷上應視為新 PR / upgrade claim，不應回寫成 August 2025 specs 的 binding data。
- 既有 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 頁已記錄 [[KT and Rohde & Schwarz to showcase AI-enhanced radio transmission performance]] 與 13 GHz FR3 demonstration；本來源新增 Qualcomm MTP powered by [[Qualcomm Modem-RF System]] 用於 FR1-FR3 carrier aggregation validation 的說法。
- 既有 [[Tingfang Ji]] 頁在 13 GHz FR3 PR 中記錄其為 Vice President of Engineering at [[Qualcomm Technologies]]；本來源更新同一人物在此 PR 中的職稱為 Vice President of Engineering and Head of 6G Research at Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.。
- 既有 [[Christian Mokry]] 頁已有多份 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] PR contact block；本來源新增同一 phone 與 press email。
